flags.message: Salience-version mismatch on all three candidates: each prediction froze band=federal under salience_version sal-v3, but the committed metrics/statpack.md renders its 'Segment base rate by salience band' table under sal-v4. Per the evaluate contract the table is no baseline for a sal-v3 band, so segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis left null for claude-baseline, codex-baseline and gemini-baseline. A statpack rebuilt under sal-v3, or a re-stamp of the frozen contexts, would be needed before a skill score can be computed for this cell.
